description: Advanced UX and interoperability extension for Wand (WeMod) app

latest_release.body:
### Features

- The patch dialog now remembers your last choices (patches, method, auto-apply, custom scripts), and the main window remembers the Wand install. By @w0wzahh in #387.
- A Re-detect button next to the install path rescans the current install after a Wand update, without restarting the app. By @w0wzahh in #387.
- A Copy diagnostics button next to the log copies the enhancer version, OS, install path, Wand version and patch state, ready to paste into a bug report. By @w0wzahh in #387.

### Fixes

- Fixed the patcher targeting an old Wand version after an update. The latest install was chosen by the folder's modification time, which a virus scan or the enhancer's own backup can bump on the previous version. It is now chosen by the version in the folder name. By @w0wzahh in #383. #374
- Restore now removes the deployed `WandEnhancerWatcher.exe`, and a file that is still locked is skipped with a warning instead of failing the Restore. By @w0wzahh in #386.
- The log now warns when a newer Wand version sits next to the selected one. By @w0wzahh in #386. #374
- Fixed the web tests failing on a source ZIP download, which stopped the build at "Test web-panel". #384

![logo](./assets/icon.svg) # WandEnhancer
> [!WARNING] > **DMCA notice.** On 2026-11-10 GitHub received a DMCA takedown notice for several files of this repository. The files named in the notice were removed from the repository and its history, so the project does not build from this repository at the moment. An open-source tool that extends the local client-side configuration of the Wand app and improves its UX. > **This project has no official downloads and no official video tutorials.** GitHub releases contain notes only, never `.exe` files. Scammers use the project's name for fake tutorials and put malware or password stealers in the video descriptions. An executable or archive from a video, a website or a mirror did not come from this project, and we are not responsible for it. The only official source is this repository. Look-alike forks and accounts are not ours. ## Network and privacy The patcher modifies files in the selected local Wand installation. By default it has no update check and no telemetry. Wand itself stays an online application. The optional remote web panel starts a LAN HTTP/WebSocket server and uses Wand API and CDN data, such as trainer translations and artwork. ## FAQ **Why is there no `.exe` in GitHub Releases?** Unsigned and self-built patching tools were repeatedly reuploaded, mislabeled and flagged by third-party scanners, so the project stopped distributing prebuilt executables. Releases are notes-only on purpose. **Can I use a binary built by someone else?** Treat it as untrusted. This repository cannot verify or support third-party builds. ## Screenshots ![1](./assets/screenshots/app1.png)
